title: Market-Value Volatility Watchlist
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), intake scans (`collection:scan`), market prices (`collection:price`), item photos (`collection:photo`), authentication records (`collection:auth`), loans (`collection:loan`), and condition audits (`collection:condition`).
app: Collection telemetry from personal catalogues, NFC scans, pricing feeds, authentication records, loan logs, shelf measurements, and item-condition audits streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:price
| stats earliest(price_usd) as start_price_usd latest(price_usd) as current_price_usd by item_id title
| eval change_pct=round(100*(current_price_usd-start_price_usd)/start_price_usd,1)
| eval abs_change_pct=abs(change_pct)
| where abs_change_pct>=10
| sort - abs_change_pct
description: Builds a watchlist of items whose tracked market value has swung significantly.
value: Some collections are stable and others are volatile, so this helps you see where repricing, insurance review, or selling decisions deserve attention.
implementation: Poll one or more pricing feeds on a regular cadence and store the values against your item identifiers.
visualization: Table of items with large positive or negative value swings.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which items in your collection have changed a lot in value lately.
